text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much, you really saved me by 
helping out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw Hishi Amazon with her hands full of 
bags in the shopping district, so I helped 
her carry them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Come to think of it, do you like sweets?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I made some sakura mochi this morning. 
It's my treat to thank you for helping me 
carry the luggage!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting. Well then, dig 
in without hesitation!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear that! Come on, eat up, eat 
up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ama-san, so this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Brian. Did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean...? Didn't I tell you to 
come by because I'd be making sakura 
mochi?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah~~!? I completely forgot! We just 
sold out right this second...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
They helped me carry some luggage earlier, 
so I treated them to a meal as a 
thank-you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, don't glare at me like that. I'm 
the one who treated you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm not glaring at you. My face just looks 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she says that, I feel like a frog 
stared down by a snake...
choice_data_list: Shall I go buy some sakura mochi?

Is there something else I can treat you to 
instead?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If it isn't Ama-san's, there's no point--

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, can't be helped then! If 
you're going that far, I'll whip some up 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's my fault for forgetting our promise, 
alright?! I'll take full responsibility!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be waiting.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna cook up something insanely 
delicious, so work up an appetite and get 
ready!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Even if you spring that on me all of 
a sudden... The only thing I can make 
right now is salted rice balls!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Even so, I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Plain salted rice balls are fine?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm starving, so anything works.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, you worked up an appetite for 
it, huh? Brian, I'm really sorry!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll whip up some salted rice 
balls in a flash, so just hold on a little 
longer!
